Method of Attack: Unauthenticated management interface API misconfiguration exposing web panel to external requests
Remote server-side request forgery (SSRF) allowing upload of malicious models leading to remote code execution
Java deserialization vulnerability in SnakeYAML library enabling remote code execution via malicious YAML files
Chaining of above vulnerabilities to compromise systems
Impacted Systems: Internet-exposed servers running TorchServe versions 0.3.0 through 0.8.1
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated access to management interface bound to 0.0.0.0
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via model configuration fetching from remote URLs
Insecure Java deserialization in SnakeYAML library via malicious model upload
